modifications: Unrigged Tripo export in 11 parts (23,936 triangles, three 2048 px textures). Rotated head-first, scaled to the previous Mosi footprint, merged into one skinned mesh on an 18-bone skeleton that keeps the old bone names and rest orientations, soft skin weights, authored idle and walk clips, textures reduced to 1024 px JPEG and the metal/roughness map removed. Built with lab/gfx-demo/tools/bake-mosi.mjs. The painted face replaces the fitted storybook eyes, the knitted scarf is left off, and the saddle and rider are refitted in dinosaurs.js.
